record.bible_text: <FO><FO>To the chief Musician<WH05329><WTH8764> upon Shoshannimeduth<WH07802>, A Psalm<WH04210> of Asaph<WH0623>.<Fo><Fo> Give ear<WH0238><WTH8685>, O Shepherd<WH07462><WTH8802> of Israel<WH03478>, thou that leadest<WH05090><WTH8802> Joseph<WH03130> like a flock<WH06629>; thou that dwellest<WH03427><WTH8802> <FI>between<Fi> the cherubims<WH03742>, shine forth<WH03313><WTH8685>. <RF>of: or, for<Rf>
